# sherpa-pagination

Results-size + page navigation control.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Pagination |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-pagination/sherpa-pagination.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-pagination/sherpa-pagination.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-pagination/sherpa-pagination.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-pagination/sherpa-pagination.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-pagination/sherpa-pagination.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-pagination data-page="2" data-total-pages="10" data-page-size="25" data-rows-options="10,25,50"></sherpa-pagination>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-locked` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-page` | number | `1` | current 1-based page |
| `data-page-size` | number |  | active rows-per-page value (default first option) |
| `data-rows-options` | text |  | comma list of rows-per-page choices, e.g. "10,25,50" |
| `data-total-pages` | number | `1` | total page count |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `number` | read and write | current page (read/write) |
| `totalPages` | `number` | read and write | total page count (read/write) |
| `pageSize` | `number` | read and write | rows per page (read/write) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `goToPage(n: number)` | Navigate to a page (clamped) and emit page-change if it changed. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `page-change` | `{ page: number }` |
| `page-size-change` | `{ pageSize: number }` |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`controls`, `page-input`, `pagination`, `results`, `rows`, `total`
